sloka: ग्राहयामास तारेयः स्वयमात्मानमात्मवान् ।बलं दर्शयितुं वीरो यातुधानगणे तदा ।। ६.४१.८४ ।।।।
transliteration: grāhayāmāsa tāreyaḥ svayamātmānamātmavān ।balaṁ darśayituṁ vīro yātudhānagaṇe tadā ।। 6.41.84 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter, Ravana who was shaken by fury repeatedly commanded his ministers and said 'Let this evil minded monkey be seized and killed'.
